previous history of intrauterine fetal death
finding: Several factors were found to be associated with GDM, including history of abortion, family history of diabetes mellitus, chronic hypertension, lower dietary diversification score, lack of regular physical exercise, history of infertility, history of Caesarean section, previous history of GDM, previous history of intrauterine fetal death, lower literacy, higher body mass index, and higher parity.
mod_finding: History of Caesarean section was associated with an increased risk of GDM (AOR 3.24 [95% CI: 1.58-6.63]).
